# Minimal actual-source parser fixture

Six numerical observations, 1990-07-02 through 1990-07-09, copied as an exact
prefix of the downloaded CSV including its format preamble and header. These are
actual provider observations; tests that alter them are explicitly synthetic
failure/precision cases. This fixture is too short for factor regression.

Source: Kenneth R. French Data Library, developed five-factor daily CSV.
[Download](https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/ftp/Developed_5_Factors_Daily_CSV.zip)
and [methodology](https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/Data_Library/f-f_5developed.html).
Data Library attribution: Eugene F. Fama and Kenneth R. French.

provenance.json records retrieval, full ZIP/member hashes and exact excerpt hash.
The full provider dataset is not redistributed in this repository. This minimal
numerical test excerpt carries no assertion of a general redistribution license.
The downloaded revision's historical publication time is unknown; its database
vintage and retrieval timestamp must not be treated as historical availability.
